desc: A sale's revenue is units * price_cents. Sum revenue per (region, product) pair over all sales. For each region that has at least one sale, in ascending code-point order of region name, return (region, product, revenue) for the product with the highest total revenue in that region; if several products tie for the highest, choose the one whose name is smallest in code-point order.

decls.ts: type Sale = { region: string; product: string; units: number; price_cents: number };
